messages:
sarah.partnerships: Heads-up 1: got 3 marketplace-introduced leads this week that overlap with SI-originated opps. How do we avoid duplicate outreach? :thinking: 
liam.si_eng: Yep saw same. Pain point: SI does pre-sales intro, then SDR intake claims later and both engage. We need a simple order-of-ops/claim gate.
elaine.revops: Proposal: first inbound touch gets ownership for 14d unless there's an explicit SFDC handoff. Also add fields so intake is deterministic.
tom.sales: 14d TTL sounds reasonable. Practically: if SI registers via portal they must set `si_claimed` + `partner_case_id`; otherwise SDR owns.
jordan.product: For joint co-announces, that should create a 30d marketing lock where marketplace promos are paused to avoid mixed messaging.
sarah.partnerships: So two gates: 1) SI-first-touch ownership TTL = 14d, 2) co-announce lock = 30d. Need exact SFDC field names and intake rules.
elaine.revops: Suggested SFDC fields: `si_claimed_by` (text), `si_claim_ts` (epoch), `coannounce_requested` (Y/N), `coannounce_lock_until` (epoch), `contract_override` (Y/N). Intake webhook should populate from partner portal/marketplace API.
liam.si_eng: We'll add a checkbox in partner portal to POST `si_claimed=true` and `partner_case_id`. Also emit a marketplace-bot ping to #partnerships when claims happen.
marketplace-bot: [automated] New claim: partner="NorthBridge" account="Acme Data" partner_case_id=NB-4523 ts=1737778001
sarah.partnerships: Nice. Also want an auto-adjudication: if SDR and SI both claim within 48h, route to a small triage queue (@si-ops + @sdr-leads) instead of letting it collide.
tom.sales: Please yes. Last time it sat unresolved for a week. A triage ping and one-touch handoff rule would help.
elaine.revops: Draft pseudo-rules (will formalize in intake spec): 
```
if si_claimed_by and not coannounce_requested:
  ownership = SI for 14 days
elif coannounce_requested:
  ownership = joint; marketing_lock = 30 days
elif multiple_claims_within_48h:
  ownership = triage_queue
else:
  ownership = SDR
```
I'll publish the exact field names and webhook spec today.
jordan.product: UX ask: show "Claimed by <partner> - contact@partner" on the marketplace listing so SDRs see status before outreach.
sarah.partnerships: Good. Action items: Elaine publish intake + SFDC fields by EOD; Liam add portal webhook next week; Jordan add listing banner to backlog; Tom update SDR playbook to honor flags. I'll set a 30m sync Thu to ratify.
liam.si_eng: I'll block Thu and run a reconciliation script for last 60d overlaps to surface problem accounts.
marketplace-bot: [automated] Meeting scheduled by sarah.partnerships: Thu 11:00am PT (invites sent)
sarah.partnerships: Thanks all :thumbsup: aim for minimal enforceable rules. If anyone has legal/commercial must-haves flag now.
tom.sales: Commercial note: where partner contract grants reserved co-sell rights, we need a `contract_override` audit flag so RevOps can force ownership.
elaine.revops: noted 1 will include `contract_override` and audit trail in spec; will add a one-line for SDR playbook.
sarah.partnerships: Closing thread 1 see invites and add notes to the meeting doc if you can't make it.
